confirmedNewBugs.title: Deleting a document removes it from every notebook-version-history snapshot, so the advertised 'Earlier notebook states, including removed files' can never restore a removed file (and the pre-delete capture's reason is rewritten to a generic label)
confirmedNewBugs.feature: F13 whole-notebook history/guarded transactions + F14 deletion cleanup
repro: 1. Notebook with file A ('Untitled', content 'PERSIST 1'). Create file B ('Untitled 2', content 'DELA'), wait ~2.5s for autosave (settled).
2. Delete file B via sidebar row menu → Delete → confirm ('This cannot be undone').

3. File → Info → Notebook version history…: the only entry is 'Before a notebook change <time> · 1 file' — the pre-delete capture that originally contained 2 files and reason 'Before deleting Untitled 2' now contains 1 file.

4. Restore it → confirmed via Continue → notebook restored WITHOUT the deleted file. The removed file is unrecoverable from notebook history despite the dialog's first line: 'Earlier notebook states, including removed files.'
confirmedNewBugs.expected: Per the dialog text, earlier notebook states include removed files; at minimum the guarded 'Before deleting X' capture retains X.
confirmedNewBugs.observed: Every recovery row's snapshot has the deleted file filtered out and its reason overwritten to 'Before a notebook change'.
controls: Guarded capture itself fires (auditGuardedMutation → auditRecoveryCapture BEFORE the mutation runs) — source-verified.
Dedup control: a capture whose scrubbed content equals current state is hidden from the list (second delete cycle) — correct dedup, not the defect.
The delete dialog's own 'This cannot be undone' warning is honored; the defect is the history dialog's false 'including removed files' promise (same defect class as counted B229 misleading-UI).
confirmedNewBugs.sourceMechanism: app-js.txt: deletion cleanup iterates auditDatabase rows — `const hasDeleted=row.snapshot?.files?.some(file=>ids.has(file.id)), clean=scrubDeletedStoredValue(row,ids); … if(hasDeleted&&clean.reason)clean.reason="Before a notebook change"; await auditDatabase("put",row.key,clean)`. scrubDeletedSnapshot: `const kept=snapshot.files.filter(file=>!ids.has(file.id))` removes the deleted file from every stored snapshot, defeating the recovery capture taken one moment earlier.
confirmedNewBugs.impact: Users relying on Notebook version history to recover a deleted file lose it permanently while the UI claims otherwise; history labels hide what actually changed.
confirmedNewBugs.fixDirection: Exempt the pre-delete guarded capture from scrubbing (or scrub only protected-file private extras per the privacy contract), and/or correct the dialog text; reconcile with the delete dialog's no-undo warning deliberately.
